posts.subject: Ban Apology for Olfy
posts.bodyHtml: I am very sorry for being toxic and nasty to players yesterday. Also I called an admin for a weak reason. I only affected one player which was Teeqo and I am sorry to him for being nasty. I love playing on dream and am very sorry for being nasty
Thank you for your ban apology, just like to know, will you do it again in the future?
no i have learnt my lesson but it could happen but probaly unlikely since i have learnt my lesson
* No it is very unlikely to happen again, but I wont swear on anyone's life because it could happen. I have learnt my lesson so it very unlikely to happen and I will never be toxic again.

Okay, you are now unbanned from our Dream servers. I hope you really did you used time well.


Welcome back to our servers,
Doo Doo
